zh.title: 星宇航空正式開航臺北至布拉格航線 首航班機由董事長張國煒親自執飛
zh.summary: 星宇航空於8月1日凌晨正式開通首條歐洲直飛航線，提供往返桃園國際機場（TPE）與捷克布拉格瓦茨拉夫・哈維爾機場（PRG）的載客服務。這項航線的啟動，代表星宇航空的營運版圖由既有的亞洲與北美市場，進一步延伸至中歐地區。 本次首航任務具備明顯指標意義，由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自駕駛執飛。星宇航空以空中巴士A350-900廣體客機執飛該航線，該機型以長程飛行效率、座艙舒適性與較安靜的客艙環境見長，適合洲際直飛航線運作。
body: 星宇航空於8月1日凌晨正式開通首條歐洲直飛航線，提供往返桃園國際機場（TPE）與捷克布拉格瓦茨拉夫・哈維爾機場（PRG）的載客服務。這項航線的啟動，代表星宇航空的營運版圖由既有的亞洲與北美市場，進一步延伸至中歐地區。 本次首航任務具備明顯指標意義，由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自駕駛執飛。星宇航空以空中巴士A350-900廣體客機執飛該航線，該機型以長程飛行效率、座艙舒適性與較安靜的客艙環境見長，適合洲際直飛航線運作。  依航班規劃，布拉格航線開航初期維持每週三班，於每週二、四、六飛航；自10月1日起，班次將增至每週四班。去程JX101自台北於凌晨00時10分起飛，預定當地時間上午7時50分抵達布拉格；回程JX102則於上午10時20分自布拉格起飛，翌日清晨5時10分返抵台北。 布拉格作為捷克首都，不僅是歷史文化資產豐富的觀光城市，也是中歐重要的交通與商務樞紐。近年隨著半導體等產業供應鏈逐步向中東歐延伸，台灣與捷克之間的商務往來日益密切；星宇航空開闢直飛航線後，可望減少旅客過往轉機所需時間，並進一步強化雙邊觀光、商務與轉運連結。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines Officially Launches Taipei–Prague Route with Inaugural Flight Piloted Personally by Chairman Chang Kuo-wei
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines officially launched its first direct European route in the early morning of August 1, operating passenger service between Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and Václav Havel Airport Prague (PRG) in the Czech Republic. The launch of this route marks the expansion of STARLUX's network from Asia and North America into Central Europe. Serving as a key milestone, the inaugural flight was personally piloted by STARLUX Airlines Chairman Chang Kuo-wei. STARLUX operates the route using Airbus A350-900 widebody aircraft, a model known for long-haul flight efficiency, cabin comfort, and a quieter cabin environment.
body: STARLUX Airlines officially launched its first direct European route in the early morning of August 1, providing passenger service between Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and Václav Havel Airport Prague (PRG) in the Czech Republic. The launch of this route marks the expansion of STARLUX's operational network beyond Asia and North America into Central Europe. The inaugural flight carried milestone significance, being personally piloted by STARLUX Airlines Chairman Chang Kuo-wei. STARLUX is deploying Airbus A350-900 widebody aircraft on the route, a type noted for its long-range efficiency, cabin comfort, and quiet cabin environment, making it well-suited for intercontinental direct flights. According to the flight schedule, the Prague route will initially operate three times weekly on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, before increasing to four weekly flights starting October 1. Outbound flight JX101 departs Taipei at 00:10 and is scheduled to arrive in Prague at 07:50 local time; inbound flight JX102 departs Prague at 10:20 and arrives back in Taipei at 05:10 the following morning. As the capital of the Czech Republic, Prague is not only a tourist destination rich in historical and cultural heritage, but also a major Central European transport and business hub. With semiconductor and other industrial supply chains expanding into Central and Eastern Europe in recent years, commercial exchanges between Taiwan and the Czech Republic have grown increasingly close. The new direct service is expected to reduce travel time previously needed for connections while further strengthening bilateral links in tourism, business, and transit.
